_comment: The archived release the manuscript cites: one place for the version, the tag, the repository and the two DOIs. version_doi identifies this exact version and is the one the manuscript prints; concept_doi resolves to the newest version and is the one the README badge and CITATION.cff advertise. AGENTS.md section 5: the same facts otherwise get written out by hand in eight files and drift. Both DOIs are null until Zenodo mints them, and submission/jxst/check_release_metadata.py keeps a placeholder, an unresolvable identifier, or the concept DOI out of the manuscript.
